title: Manuel F Probable NDE 7915
content: I was trying to get into my house through a second floor window that was about 4 meters from the ground. My father had died some months previously and scaffolding was there from building work on the property. I walked through the structures and one of them was not set properly. The structure collapsed to the floor with me. I managed to turn around and saw how everything had fallen. I told myself, 'This is it.' My life went past in a second and I was on the floor. The impact was on my head. I was radiating a blue light while I was falling. Then a Being, who was like a shadow twice my height, took me by the hand. It guided me through a dark desert, like an enormous field with hills but it was very dark. It was as if I was the only one who shone with blue light. I saw people there that I don't know. There was no fear, just tranquility and the Being who took me from this place to another; I understood that I shouldn't be there. I don't know how much time passed. Later, I opened my eyes, and my uncle and my mother were resuscitating me and I returned to consciousness.

arrival.other_being_detail: A Being "like a shadow twice my height" took the experiencer by the hand and guided them.

environment.environment_other_detail: A "dark desert" / "enormous field with hills"; very dark; the experiencer felt they were the only one shining with "blue light."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell about 4 meters when scaffolding collapsed while trying to enter a second-floor window; impact on head; later resuscitated by uncle and mother.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Blue light radiating from the experiencer while falling; guided by a shadow-like Being through a dark desert/field; saw unknown people; tranquility; returned when mother and uncle resuscitated them.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Life review occurred during/just after the fall; a blue light was present while falling; then guidance through a dark landscape and presence of unknown people; then return to consciousness during resuscitation.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer reports radiating a blue light while falling and being the only one shining with blue light in a very dark landscape.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “This is it.” / “My life went past in a second.” / “I was radiating a blue light while I was falling.” / “a Being, who was like a shadow twice my height, took me by the hand.” / “There was no fear, just tranquility.” / “I understood that I shouldn't be there.”
